description: Run A (v3): fresh spline-CLT, GPT-2 small, 1B/2B tokens, grid refine DISABLED, and a DEDUPED, train-disjoint validation holdout. dataset.dedup=true makes collection (1) keep only unique 128-token windows in val and (2) exclude every val window's content from train across all chunks (val_hashes.txt in the val dir). This fixes the v2 contamination where ~64% of val was one memorized window (val_loss ~0.24 was optimistic; true generalization nmse ~0.087). New variant/run_name + isolated gpt2_2b_v3 cache dirs so it starts fresh at ci=0 (must NOT reuse a run with existing training_state.pt). Fold in any lambda_sparsity / JumpReLU bandwidth / total_steps tuning separately.
